Create a welcoming seasonal display with this 60cm green cypress pine wreath, finished with full PVC foliage and detailed pine cones. Its natural-looking design adds texture and warmth to front doors, hallway walls, shop displays and winter event backdrops. The flexible wire structure makes it easy to shape and fluff the wreath to suit your preferred arrangement. No assembly or batteries are required, and no lighting is included, allowing the wreath to retain a classic decorative style. Use it on its own or add ribbons and other seasonal accessories. Suitable for indoor use and sheltered outdoor areas; it is not waterproof. Warning: not suitable for children under 36 months.
